content.text: As a digital creator in Kenya, you face significant barriers when it comes to processing payments for your products. Conventional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving you without a reliable way to sell your ebooks, courses, or software. This is where GitHub Pages comes into play. It offers a powerful, free hosting solution for your digital product store, allowing you to take control of your commerce process without relying on restrictive platforms. In this post, we will break down how GitHub Pages can serve as the foundation for your sovereign digital storefront, enabling you to bypass the limitations of conventional payment systems and retain full ownership of your products.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-10. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to publish web content directly from a GitHub repository. This means you can create a website for your digital products without worrying about hosting fees. The importance of this solution lies in its accessibility and simplicity. You gain full ownership of your content and have the flexibility to set up an online store that operates independently of traditional payment processors. This is crucial in regions where such processors are not available, as it empowers you to monetize your expertise and reach global audiences. By utilizing GitHub Pages, you are embracing a model of [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-23|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/full-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-how-kenyan-creators-get-paid-4|The Full]]-guide-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-6|infrastructure]] sovereignty that ensures long-term sustainability for your digital business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, GitHub Pages transforms your GitHub repository into a live website, which can serve as your digital storefront. The architecture behind it involves a few key components: a GitHub repository where your product files are stored, Markdown or HTML files for content creation, and a custom domain if desired. When a customer visits your site, they interact with these hosted files, which can include product descriptions, images, and purchase links. To manage payment processing, you can integrate a service like NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. This modular approach allows you to maintain your site easily and update products without needing extensive technical knowledge.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically built for digital creators in regions where conventional commerce platforms are inaccessible or unreliable. Whether you're an author selling ebooks, an educator offering online courses, or a developer distributing software, GitHub Pages provides a solution that transcends financial barriers. By choosing this architecture, you align yourself with a growing movement towards digital sovereignty—ensuring that your creations reach your audience without the interference of third-party services. This is not just about technology; it’s about empowerment and autonomy over your work, allowing you to thrive in a global digital economy.
GitHub Pages is a free and powerful hosting solution.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To build a successful GitHub Pages store, several components need to work in harmony. First, your GitHub repository acts as the central hub for all product files. Next, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, which allows you to accept payments without the need for KYC processes. Additionally, you can automate product delivery via Google Apps Script, which sends download links to customers immediately upon payment confirmation. These components can be linked together through simple scripts and webhooks, ensuring that every part of your infrastructure functions smoothly. This interconnectedness forms the backbone of your digital storefront, maximizing efficiency and customer satisfaction.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying your GitHub Pages store is a straightforward process. Start by creating a GitHub account and setting up a new repository for your digital products. Next, craft your website using Markdown or HTML to include product descriptions and purchase buttons. Integrate NOWPayments by following their setup guide, which allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments. Once your site is live, test the payment process to ensure everything works seamlessly. You can also enhance your site's appearance using templates available in the Complete Builder Kit, which provides you with pre-built solutions and additional resources to streamline your deployment. With these steps, you can launch your sovereign digital store today.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

GitHub Pages is an excellent solution for digital creators in Kenya looking to host an online store without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal. It allows you to publish your products for free while managing payments through alternative methods like cryptocurrency. This infrastructure empowers you to maintain ownership and control over your content, enabling you to reach a global audience effectively.
NOWPayments enables seamless cryptocurrency transactions.

For a comprehensive resource on deploying your digital storefront, consider the Complete Builder Kit. This kit includes all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your setup process, making it easier to get your GitHub Pages store up and running quickly. With the right architecture, you can start selling your digital products without any barriers.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Sign up for a GitHub account and create a new repository for your products. 2. Prepare your digital products with proper descriptions and formats. 3. Create your website using Markdown or HTML and link to your product files. 4. Set up NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions and integrate it into your site. 5. Test the payment process to confirm that customers can purchase your products seamlessly. 6. Use templates from the Complete Builder Kit to enhance your site's design. 7. Publish your GitHub Pages site, making it accessible to potential customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
What types of products can I sell using GitHub Pages?
You can sell a variety of digital products such as ebooks, online courses, software, templates, and more. The key is to ensure that they can be delivered electronically.
How does NOWPayments work with GitHub Pages?
NOWPayments allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly on your GitHub Pages site. It integrates easily and processes payments without KYC requirements.
Is there a limit on the number of products I can sell?
No, there are no inherent limits to the number of products you can sell. However, consider how you manage them in your repository for ease of navigation.
Can I customize my website's design?
Yes, you can customize your GitHub Pages site using different themes or templates. This allows you to create a unique look that matches your brand.
What if I encounter technical issues while setting up?
You can access numerous online resources, including GitHub's documentation and support forums, to help troubleshoot any technical issues that arise during your setup.
